temporary_duplication_exit_contract.memo: 180-day last_used_at operational cache cutoff; one first-preserved row/key, repeat reuse updates metadata rather than appending full records
temporary_duplication_exit_contract.memo_guards: known owner must exist/settle; no pending document/review work, awaiting/ready analysis, unsent/uncertain publication, queued/submitting intent, unconsumed/unaccounted item
temporary_duplication_exit_contract.hot_cache: reuse refreshes last_used_at; 180 days is idle expiry, not a hard wall-clock or global byte cap
temporary_duplication_exit_contract.protected_and_orphan_cache: pending/unknown/dependent and orphan-owner rows may outlive cutoff; no claim all historic rows are deleted. Broader orphan retention remains DA6.6
temporary_duplication_exit_contract.batch_body_exit: first eligible prune after consumed+accounted+provider forgotten, settled owner/no ready/deferred work; removes text/located/review_context/answer, retains IDs/accounting
temporary_duplication_exit_contract.consumer_stage: all10 current carriers preserve result refs; durable paid ledger and compact review input independent of batch bodies/memo; current full projection remains for existing consumer/baseline behavior
temporary_duplication_exit_contract.current_projection: one active Bill analysis/review baseline is working state, not a new permanent application-history body on each reuse
temporary_duplication_exit_contract.permanent_history: one immutable paid result per actual provider item; each application row is short IDs/target/outcome; no paid result rekey on ownership transfer
temporary_duplication_exit_contract.body_compaction: primary READY/foreign inline and review-memo writer OFF do not automatically fail this compatible dual-write/operational-lifetime contract; generic compaction is optional representation work
temporary_duplication_exit_contract.safety: no guaranteed hard global dump cap; required frozen/pending dependencies cannot be cut to meet size
